title: Design: Vendor card shows a deactivated term as Inactive
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • {Vendor-A} is on Net 50, and Net 50 is deactivated.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-42 Vendor.
  • Starting screen: the Vendors page.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p7-05-vendor-page-today.png, ct-p7-06-vendor-on-a-deactivated-term.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Vendor-A}.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the vendor card shows "Credit term" with "Net 50 (Inactive)" under it, whole, in the same place and style as today's card (compare ct-p7-06-vendor-on-a-deactivated-term.png and today's ct-p7-05-vendor-page-today.png).
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11675 (Story 6, Vendors)

  • S6-R3: “A vendor on a deactivated term shows "{name} (Inactive)" on the vendor card's "Credit term" and selected in Edit Vendor, listed after the active terms, until someone picks another.”
  • S6-R6: “Term names are never cut off in the vendor Credit Terms dropdown or on the vendor card, including with "(Inactive)"; long names wrap.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("Vendor page today", "Vendor on a deactivated term"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p7-05-vendor-page-today.png
  • ct-p7-06-vendor-on-a-deactivated-term.png

The design's own words:

  • “The shop deactivated Net 10. This vendor keeps it, and the card reads "Net 10 (Inactive)". Vendor bills still get their due date from it.”
